subject: info-intr
title: INFO.INTR.------TR.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-24, on the page where Braxton argues that 'the sophistication of the western defining and controlling community has helped to produce a situation where the transfer-shift implications (interpretations) of black creativity have assumed more importance than the principle thrust projection responsible for the subsequent transfers (the leaf is more important than the tree).' (C)INFO-INTR (information interpretation) is crossed with TR (transformation). The diagram poses what *information interpretation* would have to look like to actually deliver transformation rather than merely re-encoding meaning. INFO-INTR branches to C-CULT-AT (composite culture attitude) → INT (intention) → CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions). Besides the main line to TR, INFO-INTR runs to C-CONT (composite continuance), which branches to DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and to MT-IF-DB (multi-informational degree basis); MT-IF-DB branches in turn to LANG-DY (language dynamics) and LK-IMP (linkage implications). The structural argument: information interpretation's path to transformation is direct, while composite continuance carries dynamic functionalism, multi-informational degree basis and language dynamics, and culture attitude carries intention and cross-transfer definitions.
